---

Hey friends, this is a day in the life of actually running the business, filmed on a Friday at our office in Hong Kong. You'll see the two Friday firesides I run for our Lifestyle Business Academy students, a coaching call with Nathan that accidentally turned into new curriculum, me writing this week's LifeNotes using a technique called the splurge, and a slightly unplanned trip to the DJI store. It ends with a pretty honest chat with the team about what it's felt like carrying a business for the last 14 years, which is not something I usually talk about on camera. Hope you enjoy xx


⌚️ TIMESTAMPS 
0:00 Intro

2:29 Mapping the student roadmap
3:37 LifeNotes and the splurge method
4:52 Coaching call with Nathan
8:35 Why I stopped using AI to write
10:24 Marketing Superfocus
12:16 One-on-one with Angus
13:42 The weight of running a business

videos.title: The Fastest Way to Become Someone New
videos.description: Most people try to change by finding more motivation. Sometimes the better strategy is to give yourself fewer escape routes. Make the new behavior easier, and the old version of you harder to return to.

videos.title: Nobody Is Thinking About You
videos.description: Most people are way too busy thinking about themselves to spend much time thinking about you. Embarrassing? Maybe. Liberating? Absolutely.
